title: Mount Everest's Official Height Was Wrong for 65 Years, Until ...
snippet: Sep 7, 2026 · Everest is 8,848.86 metres above sea level. That figure only became official on 8 December 2020, when the foreign ministers of Nepal and China pressed a button at the same moment during a livestreamed ceremony and revealed a number neither country had published before. For 65 years, the world had been climbing, filming and writing about a mountain whose exact height nobody could actually agree on.
